ogc.serviceUrl: Service URL (anonymous, HTTP Basic or Bearer token)
ogc.owsHelp: Read-only endpoint serving WMS rendering and WFS reads. In QGIS, add the URL as a WMS/WMTS connection. Anonymously readable layers need no credentials; protected layers are challenged with HTTP Basic auth using the database's viewer password. Applications can send an Authorization: Bearer header instead — the token must match the database in the path.
ogc.wfsHelp: WFS endpoint with transaction support (WFS-T): writable layers accept inserts, updates and deletes. In QGIS, add the URL as a WFS / OGC API Features connection. Pick an SRS above to pin coordinates to a specific EPSG code — without it the service default is used. Transactions require credentials: HTTP Basic (viewer password) or an Authorization: Bearer header.
ogc.itemsLabel: Items (GeoJSON — page size 10 by default; limit, offset, bbox, crs)
ogc.rasterNoItems: Raster layer — no items endpoint, map only.
ogc.mapLabel: Map (PNG by default; f=jpeg, bbox, width, height)
ogc.apiHelp: Standards-based read-only access to OWS-enabled layers: features as GeoJSON (OGC API Features Part 1 + 2) and rendered map images (OGC API Maps Part 1). Pass crs/bbox-crs as full CRS URIs from the collection's list; versioned layers accept datetime={{isoInstant}}. Anonymously readable layers need no credentials; protected layers return 401 (anonymous) or 403 (no privilege) — send HTTP Basic or an Authorization: Bearer header matching the database. API description: OpenAPI.
ogc.wmtsHelp: The easiest way into QGIS: add the capabilities URL as a WMS/WMTS connection and pick the tileset. Anonymously readable layers need no credentials; protected tilesets are challenged with HTTP Basic auth (the database's viewer password). Applications can send an Authorization: Bearer header instead — the token cannot be put in the URL.
ogc.schemaTilesetWarning: The schema tileset ({{schema}}, {{schema}}.mvt) is drawn from every layer of the schema, so fetching it requires read access to all of them: if one layer is protected, the whole schema tileset needs credentials, even if the other layers are public. The XYZ (gmaps) URLs don't work for a schema tileset yet (GC2 answers 403); use the TMS templates.
ogc.xyzHelp: Standard XYZ axis order (top-left origin) — usable as-is with {y} in a QGIS XYZ connection, MapLibre, Leaflet or OpenLayers. Prefer this over the TMS templates unless your client specifically speaks TMS.
ogc.tmsHelp: The templates are TMS, so the y-axis is flipped compared to XYZ: in a QGIS XYZ connection write {-y} instead of {y}; in MapLibre set scheme: 'tms'. The MVT tiles' source-layer is named schema.table.

ogc.scopedOnlyHint: A {{backend}} cache can't be wiped whole; clear it by zoom range instead (runs in the background).

tileseeder.intro: Seeding pre-renders a tileset's tiles into the cache. Jobs are queued and picked up by the server within a minute, so 'pending' is normal until then.

tileseeder.threadsTip: Optional; the server default when empty.
tileseeder.nameTip: Optional label; defaults to the tileset.
tileseeder.extentLayerTip: Seed only within this layer's extent — typically a layer with a single polygon. Must be a registered layer you can read. Leave empty to seed the whole grid.
